sources.snippet: Identification: orchid-clip-v8 A fine-tune of BioCLIP 2 (ViT-L/14) on 1.14M photos of 5,124 species. Rare species were sampled more often (weight ∝ 1/√n), names were mapped to accepted species in WCVP, and images that scored badly against their own label were dropped.
